sentences.text: Cheyenne David Jackson -LRB- born July 12 , 1975 -RRB- is an American actor and singer-songwriter .
His credits include leading roles in Broadway musicals and other stage roles , as well as film and television roles , concert singing , and music recordings .	Broadway	Broadway theatre

After beginning his acting career in regional theatre in Seattle , he moved to New York and was an understudy in Thoroughly Modern Millie -LRB- 2002 -RRB- and Aida -LRB- 2003 -RRB- .	Thoroughly Modern Millie	Thoroughly Modern Millie (musical)	Aida	Aida (musical)
He next originated the role of Matthew in Altar Boyz -LRB- 2004 -RRB- .	Altar Boyz	Altar Boyz

Jackson 's first leading role on Broadway was in All Shook Up -LRB- 2005 -RRB- , which earned him a Theatre World Award for `` Outstanding Broadway Debut . ''	Broadway	Broadway theatre	All Shook Up	All Shook Up (musical)	Theatre World Award	Theatre World Award

Since then , on the New York stage , he has starred in The Agony & the Agony -LRB- 2006 -RRB- , Xanadu -LRB- 2007 ; Drama League , Drama Desk nominations -RRB- , Damn Yankees -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , Finian 's Rainbow -LRB- 2010 ; Drama Desk nomination -RRB- , 8 -LRB- 2011 -RRB- , The Heart of the Matter -LRB- 2012 -RRB- and The Performers -LRB- 2013 -RRB- .	Xanadu	Xanadu (musical)	Damn Yankees	Damn Yankees	8	8 (play)	The Heart of the Matter	The Heart of the Matter	The Performers	The Performers (play)

He has also appeared in a number of films , including the 2006 Academy Award-nominated United 93 , in which his portrayal of Mark Bingham earned him the Boston Society of Film Critics 2006 award for Best Ensemble Cast .	Academy Award	Academy Awards	United 93	United 93 (film)	Mark Bingham	Mark Bingham	Boston Society of Film Critics	Boston Society of Film Critics
